title: Join the Mafra Days conference, drawing a thread between music, heritage and climate change
content:
Mafra Days, taking place at the Royal Building of Mafra from 7-8 November 2026, will bring together leading European figures and experts from the fields of music, heritage, science, the environment and civil society, alongside youth representatives, around a shared ambition: to make music and listening catalysts for passing on heritage, fostering dialogue and strengthening European cohesion.

Organised by Hub partner Centre Européen de Musique, Mafra Days is held in the frame of the EU-funded European Heritage Hub, in collaboration with Europa Nostra, the Municipality of Mafra, and partner Centro Nacional de Cultura, which oversees the Europa Nostra Heritage Hub in Lisbon. The event is placed under the High Patronage of the President of the French Republic. Visits to cultural sites will also take place, thanks to the Museus e Monumentos de Portugal and Museu Nacional da Musica.
